repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ ## Contract review Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT` Head-sha: `c9c1d9e422e98ef60267030df7bbfb07b7f61a87` Local-runs: probe — the seat's L1 pin and ablation run at this head (vitest, three app-shell test files, throwaway worktree); every judgment below rests on the diff, the card and the head's check-runs Scope: none (no `reviewFace` hits: no published schema, no governed path; the review is owed for the DELIBERATE CORRECTION and read on the declaration face) + `.changeset/36908-remove-studio-home.md`, `.changeset/37236-customized-means-one-thing.md`, the PR body's `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` lines, and the diff files those sentences describe: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/PackageCustomizationsPanel.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/packageCustomizationRows.ts`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts` ### ① Derived judgments - **DELIBERATE CORRECTION — confirmed.** The note is `.changeset/36908-remove-studio-home.md`, #37166's pending (unreleased) changeset. It is the only foreign note the diff touches. Check Changeset job 139509776058 names only this file. One sentence changes, in the "What this environment changed on an installed app" bullet: - Before: "The count now includes tab, field-group and action-layout arrangements, so an app whose only change is a tab arrangement shows as customized." - After: "Tab, field-group and action-layout arrangements are named on their own in that line, not counted as customized." - The old sentence would ship false once this PR lands. At this head `PackageCustomizationsPanel.tsx` sets `customized: customizationTotal(read)`, and `customizationTotal` is `read.counts.overrides + read.counts.extensions` (`customizationMarks.ts:97-98`). An arrangement-only app therefore reads "0 customized", not customized. - I judge the new sentence TRUE at this head, clause by clause: - "named on their own in that line": the summary `

` joins `engine.packages.customizations.arranged` (en `{count} rearranged`, zh `调整排列 {count} 处`) between the customized and switched-off segments. It uses the line's own separator. - "not counted as customized": see the `customizationTotal` reading above. - The segment is drawn only when `state.arranged > 0`. The sentence says arrangements are named, not that a zero is named, so it is not overstated. - No other sentence in the note becomes false. "The 'n customized, m switched off' line" still names that line, and the panel, the 「Customize in Studio」 link and the one-app-at-a-time list are unchanged. - The correction is minimal: one line, +1/−1. - **The PR's own note, `.changeset/37236-customized-means-one-thing.md`, read sentence by sentence. True at head.** - "counts as customized only … overrides and extensions": true. - "the same number the All metadata header shows and the same rule its lists' 「customized」 filter uses": true. `DirectoryPage.tsx:246/249`, `ResourceListPage.tsx:741` and `useListOrderedNames.ts:173` all read `customizationTotal`. - "named on their own … only when there are any": true. - The example "3 customized, 2 rearranged, 1 switched off" / 「已定制 3 项，调整排列 2 处，已停用 1 项」 matches the two catalogues and the separator. - "reads '0 customized, 2 rearranged, 0 switched off' instead of '2 customized'": true. It is pinned exactly in `PackageCustomizationsPanel.test.tsx`. - "still lists both arrangements under the section's 「布局」 tab": true for zh-CN (`tab.arranged` = 布局). In English the tab reads "Layouts" (nit N1 in the seat's L1). - **`Clause-②: no` holds.** No `packages/spec/src/**` path is touched. - `customizedCountOf` is removed, but `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, and `packageCustomizationRows.ts` is not re-exported from its entry. - The one new key goes into the `studio` namespace of `@object-ui/i18n`, whose catalogues are typed `Record`. The key adds a runtime entry, not a type, so nothing reachable from the package's declarations widens. - The claim (7171285434), the PR body and the changeset all read `Clause-②: no` through `readClause2Line` (`declared`, value `no`, no arm). - **`Metadata-protocol: none` holds.** No metadata key, value or type changes. The UI reads the existing served `counts.arrangements`. All three carriers read `none` through `readMetadataProtocolLine`. - **i18n.** `released-keys-removed.mjs` against `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` lists the same 77 keys at this head as at the merge base `f339060f`, so the PR removes no released key. No `engine.packages.customizations.*` key exists at the tag. The new key is in both of the packs the `studio` namespace carries, `en` and `zh`, with `{count}` in each. ### ② Semver level `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` is correct for a non-protocol UI fix with one additive string. CI's `Guard against accidental major bumps` and `Require an ADR-0087 disposition` steps are `success` on job 139509776058. The job's one red step, `Reject an empty-frontmatter changeset added by this PR`, is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION refusal this record confirms. It is not a level failure. ### ③ Boundary flags - The dev's three open questions are answered by the zone's rulings (7175439691), each A, and each is consistent with ruling B (7158100447): - Q1, wording and separator: the ruling's 「·」 example was introduced with "for example". - Q2, only the arrangement segment hides at 0: 「已定制 0 项」 stays, as the ruling's example implies. - Q3, keep the correction: confirmed above. - The dev's out-of-scope note (the full app-shell suite cannot finish inside a dev turn) is carried as `noted, not filed`. It changes nothing here. - SQL push-down: the diff only changes client UI arithmetic over the already-served customization read. It adds no id materialisation and no in-app join. Nothing to record. - The author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay). - This record covers this head only. Implemented-by: `claude/issue-37236-customized-meaning` Reviewed-by: `session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ` **VERDICT: PASS** No must-fix, no should-fix.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `c9c1d9e422e98ef60267030df7bbfb07b7f61a87` · 2026-11-25T22:05Z

- **What was read.**
  - The tree and check-runs at head (`git show`/`diff`/`merge-tree`, `gh api` GET).
  - Card #37236 with ruling B (7158100447), the claim 7171285434, the report 7175069802 and the zone's finalized-head comment 7175439691.
  - The PR body and the full net diff against merge base `f339060f`.
  - The dev's narrative was not used as evidence.
- **Shape.**
  - Draft against `main`, authored by `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
  - First line `Fixes #37236`, the only closing keyword in the body, and right: the PR delivers the card's whole "Done when".
  - 9 files, +152/−45. Nothing under `content/docs/releases/`.
  - `check-governed-merges --pr 37351`: NOT governed, 197 lines, so Tier S.
  - Two files sit outside the claim's literal surface, and both are accepted:
    - `PackagesPage.installedAppsUpdates-34722.test.tsx` is the panel's sibling detail-sheet pin from #37166, updated to the new line.
    - `.changeset/36908-remove-studio-home.md` is the declared correction.
- **Ruling B → code.** 「已定制」 is now one number on every surface: `customizationTotal` (overrides + extensions, `customizationMarks.ts:97-98`, unchanged).
  - The Setup detail reads it at `PackageCustomizationsPanel.tsx`.
  - The header reads it at `DirectoryPage.tsx:246/249`, the list filter at `ResourceListPage.tsx:741`, and the ‹ › filter at `useListOrderedNames.ts:173`.
  - `customizedCountOf` is gone with its one caller and one test. There are zero references at head.
  - Arrangements get their own segment, shown only above 0. The "No changes" line now needs all three counts at 0. Rows and the 「布局」 tab are unchanged. Held.
- **Pins at head: pass, and red on ablation.** Seat run, throwaway worktree at this head.
  - Three files pass: `PackageCustomizationsPanel.test.tsx`, `metadataAreaHost.customizations-28568.test.tsx` and `PackagesPage.installedAppsUpdates-34722.test.tsx`, 69 of 69 tests.
  - Each ablation was applied alone, and each file was restored to the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`:

  | # | Mutation | Red |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | A1 | Setup detail `customized` + `counts.arrangements` | 3 of 13: mixed, en arrangement-only, zh-CN |
  | A2 | header gate + arrangements | 1 of 13: header pin |
  | A3 | `ResourceListPage` filter gate + arrangements | 1 of 13: list filter pin |
  | A4 | `useListOrderedNames` gate + arrangements | 1 of 13: ‹ › names pin (its HotCRM control stays green) |
  | A5 | drop `state.arranged === 0` from the "No changes" test | 2 of 13: en and zh arrangement-only |
  | A6 | always draw the arrangement segment | 1 of 13: "no arrangement, no arrangement segment" |
  | A7 | `customizationTotal` itself + arrangements | 7 of 69, across all three files |

  A1–A4 reproduce the PR's own ablations. A5–A7 are the seat's own.
- **DELIBERATE CORRECTION.** It is justified, minimal (+1/−1, one sentence) and declared in the PR body with the old and new sentence. The diff changes code, so the confirmation is the same-head `TIER_DEFAULT` contract-review PASS (`references/landing-operations.md`). That record is posted beside this one and judges the sentence TRUE clause by clause.
- **Check Changeset red, accepted as red by design.** Job 139509776058 fails only at the step `Reject an empty-frontmatter changeset added by this PR`. Its error names `.changeset/36908-remove-studio-home.md` and the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class. The ADR-0087 and major-bump steps are `success`. All three 〈路径分叉〉 conditions hold:
  - (1) The source says the red is by design on the pushed branch. `check-empty-changeset.mjs` prints the correction remedy ("the dispatching seat confirms it by its own record"). `pr-automation.yml` (the "Past a designed red" block) names the foreign-changeset refusal on a PR that corrects a note and adds its own as RED BY DESIGN, left standing.
  - (2) The job does not run on `merge_group`: `pr-automation.yml` triggers on `pull_request` only, and Check Changeset is not a required context.
  - (3) This comment names the gate and the reason. No PR comment carried it before this one, because the zone's note 7175439691 is on the card.
- **i18n.**
  - `released-keys-removed.mjs` against `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` finds the same 77 keys at head as at the merge base, so no released key is removed. `engine.packages.customizations.*` is absent at the tag.
  - The new `engine.packages.customizations.arranged` is in both packs the `studio` namespace carries (`en`, `zh`), with `{count}` in each.
  - `check:i18n-keys` is green in the push gates, and Lint UI and Test UI are `success`.
- **`Clause-②`.** `no` is right: app-shell is private, and the studio catalogues are `Record<string, string>`.
  - The card's newest `Claim:` (7171285434), the PR body and the new changeset each read `Clause-②: no` through `readClause2Line`: `declared`, value `no`, no arm.
  - Each reads `Metadata-protocol: none` through `readMetadataProtocolLine`.
  - The claim matches the body. `Skills-docs:` is not owed.
- **Check-runs at head.** 58 runs: 44 `success`, 13 `skipped` (all expected), 1 `failure` (Check Changeset, above).
  - `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI`, all 16 `Test UI` shards, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are `success`.
  - `l1-face.mjs --pr 37351` flags only that red.
- **K = 6, merge-tree clean.** The merge base is `f339060f`, and `origin/main` is `134b71db`. `main` moved one commit (#37350) since the zone read K = 5. `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main c9c1d9e4` exits 0, and so does the same check against Version Packages #35129 at `62818bba`.
- **维护者速读.** Four lines of Chinese business prose:
  - who, where, before and after;
  - the topic (Studio 改版) and the one meaning;
  - display-only risk, which can be reverted;
  - 「无」.
  There are no code names, paths, ruling letters or bare card numbers. The example 「已定制 0 项，调整排列 2 处，已停用 0 项」 matches the en pin's two-arrangement fixture and the zh catalogue. Accurate.
- N1 — The new changeset says the arrangements are listed "under the section's 「布局」 tab". In English that tab reads "Layouts" (`tab.arranged`). "the section's Layouts tab (「布局」)" would read right in both languages. This is prose only and needs no new head.
- N2 — The os-dev report (7175069802) quotes the zh-CN pin as 「…调整排列 2 处…」. The test pins a one-arrangement fixture, 「已定制 0 项，调整排列 1 处，已停用 0 项」, which the PR body's table states correctly. This is a report wording slip only.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- **Landing.** The zone lands it: Tier S, not governed, under 3,000 lines. K = 6 < 15, so no main merge is owed first.
  - Post the same-head `TIER_DEFAULT` record and this comment on the PR, then run `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.
  - The DELIBERATE CORRECTION is confirmed by the same-head record. The seat accepts the red-by-design `Check Changeset`, so the PR enters the queue carrying it.
  - On MERGED, `Fixes #37236` closes the card. The zone then removes `pm:dispatched` and the assignee, and leaves an `ACCEPT → PR #37351 comment` pointer line on the card that names this comment's id.
